text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Passing the 400-meter sign!!
Surging into the lead is—!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa――

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (An unprecedented sense of unity――)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel everything...
Everyone's feelings... dreams... fervor—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (The soul's cry: "I want to win!")

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (The cheering voices of everyone watching—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (I dedicate this music to all who love racing.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (And—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: This victory————is for you!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Sounds of Earth!!
It's Earth!! Earth is coming through!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth crosses the finish line!!!
Her sound echoes high and clear
across Nakayama Racecourse right now!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Beniiiiiissimo!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What the...!? What just happened...!?
Wait, what...!? I felt like I was watching her
from crazy close just now...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
My heart is pounding sooo hard...!!
It feels like it isn't even mine...!!
What is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! This is insane...!!
I'm completely at a loss for words...!
I've never seen a race like this in my life...!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――... "Molto Bene."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I can feel it now.
Everyone... is truly connected.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
Truly, congratulations... child of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Is this your...
music of "love"—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I feel like... the voices of the crowd
were reaching me from sooo close by—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "M-Me too...! And Kita-chan, and all the other Umamusume... I felt so close to everyone...!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I totally get it!! Me too!!
What is this, it's amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...It's not just me...?
Everyone can feel it...—"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
This is what she's capable of.
...Well, honestly, today's the first time
I've seen her reach this level, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Aurum Star-san...
She really is, after all—

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: Needless to say.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Representing our "One-of-a-Kind Generation of Resonant Brilliance"!
The finest maestro, Sounds of Earth!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Direttore!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Direttrice!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah—

—Sounds of Earth throws her arms around me.
Fresh from her run, I can feel the heat
radiating from her body...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Did we manage to become one?

âI truly saw it, heard it, and felt it.
The music that Sounds of Earth created today.

"Everyone was completely united
in emotion and sheer excitement...!!"
choice_data_list: It really was... the ultimate music...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Grazie, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth!! Thank you so much for the greatest race ever!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Lead me to another amazing race!!
I want to hear even more of your music!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie... to everyone in the audience...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race was made possible by me, the Umamusume who ran,
and every single person who supported us—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This music was only made possible
because every single person who watched this race was here...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I swear it right here and now!!
I, Sounds of Earth,
shall continue to play my melody from here on out!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The greatest music... together with all of you!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And please, give another round of tremendous applause!!! To everyone who made this race possible!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

...And so the Arima Kinen drew to a close
with a profound sense of unity—
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —It's finally complete, Trainer.
The musical piece that Sounds of Earth had been composing for these past three years—

I was told that the music capturing our journey together
had finally been completed...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
First, I wanted you to see it for yourself.
So I brought the sheet music.
The sheet music handed over included annotations by Sounds of Earth indicating which era each melody was inspired by, making it very easy to understand...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Did you notice?
Yes, this musical piece is... a duet.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You know...
I want to perform this piece together with you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's bound to be the best session ever.
...What do you think?
choice_data_list: ...We'll have to practice a lot, won't we?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's alright! Of course, I'll teach you.
Take your time, without rushing—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: With love, of course.
It became a secret promise just between the two of them—
The music continues on from here.
